name: Megas
source:
Rogles' brother, another powerful magician from The Dark World. He's a cruel leader in Rogles' army and a bloodthirsty warlord. Megas' body was disfigured long ago, so his body has cyborg enhancements. He also keeps a tentacle monster underneath his cloak. That's a sure sign of an evil villain if I've ever seen one.

[spoiler]Deep down, despite being a rape monster, Megas is a broken man. Rogles took away what he felt was his rightful kingdom and has become obsessed with reclaiming what is rightfully his.[/spoiler]

He also shares Rogles' uncanny ability to fuck a girl so hard she grows a penis.
translation:
罗格斯的兄弟，同样是来自黑暗世界的强大魔法师。他是罗格斯军队中残酷的领导者，也是嗜血的军阀。梅加斯的身体很久以前就被毁容，因此接受了半机械改造。他还在斗篷下藏着触手怪物。只要见过邪恶反派，就知道这是明确的标志。

[spoiler]尽管梅加斯是个强奸怪物，内心深处却是个破碎的人。罗格斯夺走了他认为本应属于自己的王国，因此他执着于夺回自己的东西。[/spoiler]

他还拥有与罗格斯相同的诡异能力：把女孩操弄到长出阴茎。
